title: Quantitative trace-reconstruction bounds with a uniform decoder

result.label: Quantitative trace-reconstruction bounds with a uniform decoder
result.statement: At every fixed deletion probability in (0,1), reconstructing an arbitrary length- n binary string requires n^ ( n) independent traces, ruling out polynomial-sample reconstruction. A uniform decoder achieves quasipolynomial sample and running-time bounds for known fixed rational retention probabilities. When the deletion probability is at most n^ - for fixed ε > 0, both bounds become polynomial in the input and parameter encoding.
